question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9045a78a36bb3d3665022da0e1cce2be71db9a9beb10d83b16b55b8afabfdc32.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is

In a mirror image left changes to right and the right changes to left.

when placement of mirror not given, by **default** we will assume it in **VERTICAL DIRECTION.**

The letter adjacent to the mirror, will appear adjacent to it after the mirror just with the left changed to right and right changed to left.

Also, the starting letter of the word will be at last after the mirror.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc56a4b5d9685bb2db4aa3e0bc5b31e8d2f15cd10b921bb0c9921cdcd3bbe63b.png]
